message:
Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001], I couldn’t see any file if one was attached.
Please resend it so I can provide an accurate quote.
I’ll review it and respond within a few minutes.

Yes, I can assist with stamping your project.
Do you have a target timeframe or budget?

Given how simple the project is, I expect the review and stamp to be completed in 2 business days. Since this is a very simple change, I was hoping to have it stamped for \$100. Please let me know. Thanks

Yes, the project is simple, but the document contains 36 pages, so that quote may be too low.
Could we agree on $200-250 with completion within the next 24-36 hours?
Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001], are you still with me?

Although the 36 pages may look daunting, you do not actually need to review all of them. I initially thought the same, but the work only involves reviewing the minor modifications identified in the word file. I am a mechanical PE for this change, and my scope was reduced to the attached file \(only the highlighted portion\). The situation is the same for electrical. If it works for you, let’s settle on \$150, and I will notify the client. Please advise.
Okayyy, let's procced
Please send a contract so that we can begin.
Thanks. I’ll notify the client and initiate the offer as soon as I receive confirmation.
Alright

Additionally, could you let me know whether you can support me with the attached project? Please provide your price and timeline for permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with an electrical PE stamp \(I will handle the Mechanical and Plumbing stamp\).
Yes, I can assist with that too.
what is your budget?
Please provide a reasonable quote, and I’ll check whether it fits the client’s budget.

Would $300 work?
Also, when will the project be ready to kickoff?
For this one, the client wants to know whether you require redline drawings or can stamp it using the provided description file explaining what changed.
In my opinion, the redlined drawing is the best document to stamp because it shows what was completed in response to the previous comment.

Okay, I’ll ask the client about that. To confirm, this will include permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with all required load calculations \(T 24 is not needed, but HvAC sizing calculations are\), correct? Could you also provide your California electrical PE license number? The project should kick off soon \(within no more than two weeks\).
My understanding was that the scope only covered review and stamping. Will I also be responsible for providing additional drawings and calculations?

Understood. What if the client supplies pictures of the changes that align with the description? If you still require redlines, I will request them; I just wanted to determine the minimum information needed to kickoff the project.

At minimum, I would normally require the following to kick off the project:
The written scope of work, which has already been provided
Photos showing each modified area
The room numbers connected to each change
Any sketches, screenshots, or informal markups indicating the approximate work locations

Name: ADLER J ROBERT
License Number: 16119
Credential: Electrical PE

Apologies for the delayed reply. You would create the drawings and stamp the electrical drawings \(I will stamp the mechanical drawings\). You would also perform whatever calculations are required to produce the drawings \(please let me know whether that is within your competence\). This includes Manual. J, Manual S,,Manual D as applicable.
Given this scope, what price and timeline would you propose?

Thank you for clarifying. Yes, this scope is within my capabilities. My estimated fee for the electrical permit drawings, PE stamp, necessary electrical calculations, and Manual J/S/D calculations as applicable would be $5,000–$8,000. The estimated turnaround is approximately 3–4 weeks, provided that the architectural background files are complete and permit-ready.

This is an extensive scope.

Hmm, that seems like a lot. Just out of curiosity, have you completed projects of a similar size, and do clients typically pay this amount? I’m asking because I don’t want to accept a job that is too large and cannot be delivered, while also wanting to ensure that the price I request is not completely outside the normal range. Thanks for your help, Abigail.

Yes, I’ve handled projects with comparable size and complexity, and this fee range is fairly standard when calculations, permit drawings, and PE stamping are included. Your pricing does not appear to be outside the market. The important point is to ensure you are comfortable with the scope and can confidently support the project throughout permitting.
Understood. I’ll present this pricing to the client and update you with their feedback. Thanks.
My Pleasure
Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001], is the project still available?
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I contacted the client and am waiting for their response.
Okay, I’ll wait for your response as well.
Certainly, I’ll let you know.
Great
Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001], have you received any update from the client?

Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

The client’s latest response was:

“A formal offer is being sent. I’m waiting for the electrical redlines, and we have received the pictures.”

I’m still waiting for the offer. Thanks.

What does that mean for us?
Are we still involved in the project?
This client has been slow to respond, so he may contact me once he receives the redline, but I would not rely on that. If he does respond, I’ll contact you. Thank you!
Alright

Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I hope you’re doing well!

The client contacted me to ask whether you can stamp the changes without redlines, possibly by adding a letter describing the change you are approving. Would that be feasible? If so, I can send you the formal offer. Please advise.

Could you also resend the PE name and license number? I’m finding different information for license #: 16119 on the Nevada PE website.

Thanks,
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

Thank you for getting back to me.
Yes, that approach is possible.
Could you prepare the letter so I can stamp everything together?
Also, I was not the person who provided license # 16119.

DAVIDOW CLIFFORD
No. 004924

We will use this license to stamp your project.
Also, could the budget be increased to $200 now that the scope includes a stamped letter?
Thank you, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] changes are included in the word file eat, which I have attached again for convenient reference.
Since the scope included a PE stamp from the outset, could we cap it at $170?
Alright
send the offer
Please also send the plan again so I can confirm it.
Certainly, it is attached. Please let me know if you have any questions.

I noticed stamps on some of the pages.
Just to clarify, which pages will receive the electrical stamp?

The .pdf file is a copy of the as built drawings, meaning those drawings show the conditions before this project introduced changes. The electrical revisions completed under this project are identified in the word file that you are reviewing and approving so the as built electrical drawings can be amended as part of this project.

Whichever option is easier for you, you may either stamp the word file and add a cover letter, or mark up the existing pdf with redlines and stamp it to indicate your concurrence with the changes made.
I think I’ll stamp the word file and prepare a cover letter confirming that it has been done.
I asked the client to send pictures of the changes so that you can use them to verify that the work was completed as specified in the word file eat.
Correct

Alright,
I’ll provide an update soon.
Thanks
Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001]
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]
The project is complete
I wanted to find out when the second milestone is going to be activated.

Thanks. The second milestone will be completed as soon as the client accepts the delivery. I retained it so we could incorporate any client/city’s comments if the stamped method is not accepted or if they request changes to the confirmation method.
I conservatively selected Aug 20, although I do not anticipate it taking that long.

I understand.
I’ll deliver the stamped word document, after which you can approve the first milestone and activate the second one.
You will then hold the second milestone payment until you receive confirmation.
That arrangement keeps both of us safe.
Here is the letter. Please review it before I get it stamped in case any corrections to the wording are needed.
That sounds good. I’ll review it and get back to you. Thanks, [FREELANCER_NAME_001], for the quick turnaround.
my pleasure
Please release the payment for the letter and stamped note so that you can activate the second milestone.
Sure. I’m currently traveling and not at my computer, but I’ll review it at the first opportunity and release the payment as well.
okay
Thanks

Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
I stopped during my travels and had an opportunity to review the letter. It looks good, but it is missing the PE stamp. Could you please sign it and return it to me?
I’m referring to this; please stamp it if you can. Thanks.
Yes, please release the first payment and activate the second one.
i will send immediately
Perfect, released the payment, thanks

The second milestone has not been activated.
Having it active would let me know that I’m waiting for your confirmation with the city.

Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001]
are you there?
Sorry, I stepped away for a few minutes. Can you check now? I believe it is active, so please confirm.
This is the stamped letter
Thanks, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]. I believe the signature block still reads “engineer name “. It needs to be changed to the actual name.
okay
The date must also use the US format. It currently shows 18/07/2026, but it should read 07/18/2026.
All good now?
Looks good, thanks
I’m looking forward to receiving the client’s response.

Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I hope you’re doing well!

Thank you. We received the client’s electrical notes. The stamped note was good and the drawings were fine; he only wanted specific items called out. I included their request along with the information provided by the electrician. Could you please stamp these callouts? They are part of the original scope, just presented in greater detail.

Thanks

Thank you very much for the revision.
However, you are aware that this was not part of our original scope because these are additional stamps.

Thank you for your response, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]. These callouts contain the same information you stamped in the letter. Rather than appearing as written statements, they are now presented as drawings. You can see that your letter specifies the heading for each callout, while the corresponding description is depicted in the drawing.

Could you please reconsider and stamp the original scope in drawing format? Addressing the city/client’s comments is part of the second milestone.
Thank you in advance for your support.
Appreciate it, thanks!
Could you release the payment now?
I understand. I will release it as soon as the client accepts it; I will not wait for City's approval, despite that being listed in the milestone.

Hello [CLIENT_NAME_001], how have you been?
I haven’t received any updates from you about the project.
